workload: Three LUTs and one 12MP export warmed before baseline; 20 import/edit cycles and 10 measured exports.
assessment: Thread and file-descriptor counts stay exactly constant at 45 and 214. Post-GC Java/native end deltas are 32688/59392 bytes with nonpositive fitted slopes; graphics PSS declines by 26800128 bytes. The recorded workload shows no sustained retained-resource growth after warmup.
limitations: This finite run does not prove absence of every leak.
100ms export memory samples are lower bounds on peak allocations.
Graphics PSS is a device-reported counter, not a complete GPU allocation inventory.
